doc: Fitted to the 2026-10-02 trace of DiskANN build_disk_index (diskannpy 0.7.0): SIFT1M, degree 64, build list 100, 13 shards (build memory 0.25 GB), 20 threads. The compute is the traced run's under strace, not fitted: PQ training 59 s and the partition 91 s as traced, and 20 s per shard, the 407 s of the whole build less those two over its 13 shards (an upper bound: the merge, the layout, and the I/O are in it).
